description.id: Harta harus dimiliki secara sah dan memenuhi nisab serta ketentuan waktu yang berlaku. Perincian utang, aset produktif, dan penggabungan aset berbeda menurut fikih dan regulasi.
description.en: Wealth must be lawfully owned and meet the applicable threshold and timing rules. Treatment of debt, productive assets, and aggregation differs by jurisprudence and regulation.

description.id: Nilai emas atau perak yang memenuhi nisab dan haul dikenai zakat menurut ketentuan yang diikuti. Harga acuan, nisab dalam mata uang, dan perlakuan perhiasan harus merujuk otoritas lokal.
description.en: Gold or silver meeting the threshold and holding period is zakatable under the followed rules. Reference prices, currency thresholds, and jewelry treatment must follow local authority guidance.

description.id: Persediaan yang diniatkan untuk dijual dinilai pada waktu perhitungan, lalu disesuaikan dengan kas, piutang, dan kewajiban menurut metode yang diakui otoritas setempat.
description.en: Inventory intended for resale is valued at the assessment date, then adjusted for cash, receivables, and liabilities under a locally recognized method.

description.id: Zakat dipertimbangkan saat panen. Jenis hasil, nisab, tarif berdasarkan metode pengairan, dan pengurangan biaya mengikuti pendapat fikih serta otoritas pertanian/zakat lokal.
description.en: Zakat is assessed at harvest. Eligible produce, threshold, irrigation-based rate, and expense deductions follow the applicable juristic view and local agricultural or zakat authority.
